lines.en: I decide to spend the night hanging out with Tsuneyo in her dorm.
lines.zh: 我决定今晚去 Tsuneyo 的宿舍和她待着。

lines.en: And by 'hanging out' I mean that we essentially stare at each other without saying anything for an hour or two.
lines.zh: 而所谓「待着」，其实基本上就是我们一言不发地互相对视一两个小时。

lines.en: And not in the romantic or sexual way either. It's sort of like an awkward exchange between two people who have no idea what to say, so they elect to say nothing instead.
lines.zh: 而且也不是浪漫或性意味上的那种。更像是两个完全不知道该说什么的人之间的一场尴尬交流，于是他们选择干脆什么都不说。

lines.en: Such is dating in this day and age.
lines.zh: 这个时代的约会就是这样。

lines.en: Eventually, she starts talking about soup because she is Tsuneyo and it is the only thing she has a defined opinion on.
lines.zh: 最后她开始聊起汤，因为她是 Tsuneyo，而那是她唯一有明确看法的话题。

lines.en: It's a little strange to me how she's managed to get so far in life with what seems to be no feelings whatsoever.
lines.zh: 我有点想不通，她看起来毫无感情，是怎么在人生里走到这么远的。

lines.en: But I'm sure that line of thinking is just me being presumptuous and not taking into account her situation at home.
lines.zh: 不过我敢肯定，这种想法只是我自以为是，没有考虑到她家里的情况。

lines.en: Eventually, it gets dark and Tsuneyo asks me if I'd like to walk with her to the store so she can buy some things for her room.
lines.zh: 后来天黑了，Tsuneyo 问我愿不愿意陪她走到商店去，好给她的房间买点东西。

lines.en: I agree and the two of us set out into the night, parting ways once we get to a nearby 7/11.
lines.zh: 我答应了，我们俩走进夜色，到了附近一家 7/11 便分道扬镳。

lines.en: And even though there weren't many words exchanged between the two of us, I still can't help but feel like we've grown closer...
lines.zh: 虽然我们之间没说上几句话，我还是忍不住觉得我们更亲近了一点……
